title: Bayard Rustin and the Organizer Behind the March
short_teaser: Bayard Rustin helped organize the 1963 March on Washington, bringing deep skill in logistics and nonviolent strategy.
story: Bayard Rustin helped organize the 1963 March on Washington, bringing deep skill in logistics and nonviolent strategy. History often depends on people whose work is essential but less visible. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
